story.sv: Bistro Norden oppnade 2020 med en enkel ide: att servera arlig, skandinavisk mat lagad fran grunden.
story.en: Bistro Norden opened in 2020 with a simple idea: to serve honest, Scandinavian food made from scratch.

chef.sv: Kockarna anvander lokala ravaror fran sasong.
chef.en: The chefs use local, seasonal ingredients.
